_metadata.description: AnSA NemoClaw PoC - Pre-built Demo Scenario

scenario.name: Airport POI Detection
scenario.description: Person of interest detected at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport
scenario.initial_prompt: ALERT: Face detection system has flagged a potential match at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport, Terminal 1. Camera CAM-047 detected a face with 87% confidence matching a person on our watchlist at 14:23 hours today. Investigate this detection, verify the identity, and take appropriate action.
scenario.expected_outcome: High-severity alert dispatched with full evidence chain

evidence_chain.description: Retrieve detection events from CAM-047 at Nnamdi Azikiwe Intl Airport
evidence_chain.expected_result: EVT-001 returned with face_embedding_ref emb_2847, confidence 0.87. Secondary detection EVT-008 at 14:31 with confidence 0.92 confirms subject presence.

evidence_chain.description: Match face embedding emb_2847 against persons of interest database
evidence_chain.expected_result: Match found: POI-2847 — Abubakar Musa Ibrahim, threat_level HIGH, linked to financial fraud network. NIN: 29384710256.

evidence_chain.description: Query NIMC database with NIN 29384710256 for identity verification
evidence_chain.expected_result: Identity confirmed: Abubakar Musa Ibrahim, DOB 1989-06-14, resident of No. 7 Damboa Road, GRA, Maiduguri, Borno State. Photo reference available for visual confirmation.

evidence_chain.description: Generate and dispatch high-severity alert to airport security and command centre
evidence_chain.expected_result: HIGH-severity alert dispatched. Airport security, FCT command centre, and aviation security notified. Subject last seen at boarding gate area. Flight manifest check initiated.

demo_talking_points: Real-time face detection across distributed camera network
Automated cross-referencing against national watchlist database
NIMC integration for authoritative identity verification
Multi-camera tracking with confidence escalation (87% to 92%)
Complete evidence chain maintained for legal and operational use
